THE S.S. "AUSTRALIAN" MODELLED

Scale model of S.S. "Australian" a passenger liner of the late 90's. This model is eight feet long and is correct in practically every detail. Electric motors take the place of turbines, and artificial smoke is produced to carry out the effect. Major Thead proposes to sail a different type of model from his fleet each Saturday on the Round Pond, weather permitting, for some weeks to come.

JOUVENILE REGATTA AT RYDE

The juvenile regatta held on the Canoe Lake at Ryde yesterday Sept 8th included many novel features. There were plenty of entries in the paddle-boat events, and lots of fun in the obstacle race and the duck hunt. Although it was the thirteenth of these annual meetings, nobody suggested that it was unlucky.
Photo shows. Not good enough to cross the Atlantic perhaps, but awfully jolly little craft.
